# The Hindu

> > India's leading English-language news organization delivering breaking news, in-depth analysis, and premium journalism across politics, sports, science, and global affairs.

The Hindu is one of India's oldest and most trusted news sources, offering comprehensive coverage of national and international news with a strong emphasis on data journalism, investigative reporting, and premium subscriber content. The platform provides live updates, breaking news, and curated coverage across multiple verticals including elections, politics, sports, health, science, and entertainment.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- India News
- Elections 2025
- International News
- Geopolitics
- Indian Politics
- West Asia Conflict
- Data Journalism
- Premium Content
- Live Updates
- Sports & Cricket
- Science & ISRO
- Health & Wellness
- State News
- Business & Technology

## Breaking News & Headlines

- [The Hindu Homepage](https://www.thehindu.com): Main homepage with breaking news, politics, sports, business and trending content
- [News Hub](https://www.thehindu.com/news): Central news hub with breaking updates on business, politics, sports and world news
- [Live News](https://www.thehindu.com/topic/live-news): Real-time live news updates with breaking coverage of elections, politics and current events

## National & Political Coverage

- [National News](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national): National news and breaking headlines from India covering politics and government
- [2025 Election Coverage](https://www.thehindu.com/elections): Comprehensive 2025 election coverage with schedules, results, polls and constituency updates
- [State News](https://www.thehindu.com/news/states): State news aggregation covering Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu and other states
- [City News](https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities): City news from Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi covering local events and civic issues

## World News & Geopolitics

- [International News](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international): International news with global coverage including Middle East, geopolitics and conflicts
- [Ground Zero](https://www.thehindu.com/topic/Ground_Zero): Investigative journalism coverage on West Asia conflicts and geopolitical developments

## Sports, Science & Entertainment

- [Sports News & Live Scores](https://www.thehindu.com/sport): Sports news, live scores, cricket updates, IPL coverage and multi-sport results
- [Science & Technology](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/science): Science news covering ISRO, space technology, research breakthroughs and discoveries
- [Health & Wellness](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/health): Health news covering medical treatment, diseases, nutrition, COVID-19 and wellness
- [Entertainment News](https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment): Entertainment news with Oscars coverage, Bollywood, movies, music and celebrity interviews

## Opinion & Data Journalism

- [Opinion & Analysis](https://www.thehindu.com/opinion): Opinion section with editorials, commentary and analysis on politics and current affairs
- [Data Stories & Visualizations](https://www.thehindu.com/data): Data journalism, interactive visualizations, fact-checking and investigative analysis

## Premium & Subscriber Content

- [Premium News](https://www.thehindu.com/premium): Premium subscriber content featuring elections, health, technology and exclusive news
- [Premium E-Books](https://www.thehindu.com/premium/ebook): Premium e-books collection including 'The Many Assams' and other subscriber exclusive publications

## Account & Support

- [My Account](https://www.thehindu.com/myaccount): User account management, authentication, subscriptions and member benefits portal
